__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A beast is the size of the largest common dog.  It has a greenish coat with
brown spots.  Its shape, along with its colors, make this cooshee almost
undetectable as it moves.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A rather large dog is here, wandering the valley.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dog cooshee

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This elf is almost as tall as you are, but much slimmer and agile.  You see
hatred in his eyes, and you try to avoid his stare.  His tense body looks ready
to spring upon you, like a mountain lion stalking its prey.  He sees you
noticing him, and quietly disappears.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A valley elf wanders here, cautious of your intrusion.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This elf is almost as tall as you are, but much slimmer and more agile.
She glares at you, then quickly disappears before you see more of her.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A female valley elf wanders here, skirting between the tall grasses.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This elf is almost as tall as you are, but much slimmer and more agile.
He glares at your intrusion and attacks with menace.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A valley elf sentry stands here, then noticing you, attacks quickly!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf sentry valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This elf is almost as tall as you are, but much slimmer and more agile.
She glares at your intrusion and attacks with menace.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A valley elf sentry stands here, then noticing you, attacks quickly!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf sentry valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The elf notices your intrusion and attacks with determination.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A valley elf scout wanders the valley, searching for intruders like you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf scout valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is currently doing some menial chores, and ignores your intrusion except
when you are in her way.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A valley elf is here, doing her duties.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This elf looks quite old, probably twenty or more times your age.  He looks
quite potent, though.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
A valley elf elder is here, studying.  He notices you.
A valley elf elder shouts 'You have intruded wrongly.  Be prepared to die!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf elder valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This elf looks quite old, probably twenty or more times your age.  She looks
quite potent, though.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
A valley elf elder is here, studying.  She notices you.
A valley elf elder says 'Your arrogance will be your end, human.'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elf elder valley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This big beast looks like a small red dragon, but has many more heads than a
regular dragon, too.  It doesn't look happy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A big beast with many heads, each breathing fire, stares at you with malice.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pyrohydra pyro hydra

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old hermit sits here, smoking a pipe.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hermit man old

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Talemon looks harmless, but the fireballs he throws at you don't.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old mage busies himself with some chemicals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle talemon wizard mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This daemon is unhappy with its summoned job, and is willing to take out it's
anger at you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge guardian daemon is here, watching the treasure.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guardian daemon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The wolf is covered with brown hair.  It looks at you with fright.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wolf is here, looking for small prey.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wolf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
With horns and spots over coarse, brown hair, this beast is the spit and
image of ... an antelope.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An antelope is here, peacefully munching on grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle antelope
